lifestyle-health.excerpt: Research published in JAMA Network Open found that high school students frequently exposed to cannabis and e-cigarette posts on social media were significantly more likely to initiate substance use within a year.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Relevant to Indian-American parents navigating teen social media use and substance exposure risks in U.S. schools.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Fructose Emerges as Unexpected Driver of Cancer Metastasis in New Study
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Researchers at The Wistar Institute found that fructose released by chemotherapy-surviving cancer cells acts as a signal for tumors to spread, raising questions about diet's role in cancer progression.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The findings are relevant to Indian-American families given the prevalence of sugary drinks and processed foods in the U.S. diet, and raise awareness about dietary factors that could influence cancer treatment outcomes.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Brain Wave Patterns at Age Nine Can Predict Depression Years Later, Study Finds
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A seven-year longitudinal study by Chinese researchers identified distinct brain-wave signatures emerging at age nine that forecast adolescent vulnerability to anxiety and depression by age 13.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Mental health awareness is a growing priority in the Indian diaspora, where objective screening tools could help overcome cultural stigma around psychological conditions.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Focusing on Your Body Can Calm Inflammation, Israeli Researchers Find
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A preregistered study from Bar-Ilan University found that directing attention toward bodily sensations reduced acute immune responses by 1.5-fold, with roughly 90% of participants showing the effect.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The findings offer scientific validation of body-awareness principles embedded in yoga and Ayurvedic traditions, long practiced in the Indian diaspora.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: ICMR Study Links Vitamin D and B12 Deficiencies to Higher Dementia Risk in Indian Adults
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A landmark study of 570 adults in Telangana found that nearly 40% had elevated dementia risk, with deficiencies in vitamins D, B2, B6, and B12 significantly more common among those at higher risk.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: NRIs with aging parents in India should ensure elderly family members maintain adequate vitamin intake and dietary diversity, especially B12 for vegetarians.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Bioengineered Chewing Gum Cuts Oral HPV by 93% in Cancer Study
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Researchers at the University of Pennsylvania have developed a bean-derived chewing gum that dramatically reduced levels of HPV and cancer-linked bacteria in oral samples from head and neck cancer patients, while leaving beneficial bacteria intact.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Mumbai Gets Its First Dedicated Wine Bar as Pique Opens in South Mumbai's Horniman Circle
food.excerpt: Founded by Le Cordon Bleu graduate Sasha Goenka, the two-level wine bar aims to make wine culture an everyday habit in a city that has embraced craft beer and specialty coffee but not yet the grape.
food.image_caption: A wine glass and sharing plates at a bar counter in Mumbai. Pique, a new wine bar at Horniman Circle in South Mumbai, aims to make wine an everyday habit in the city.
food.nri_angle: For NRIs who grew up watching Mumbai's dining scene evolve from Irani cafés to craft cocktail bars, Pique signals the next chapter — a wine-first culture that borrows from European neighborhood bars while showcasing Indian winemakers.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Coastal Curry Brings South Indian Flavors to Scarborough, Maine
food.excerpt: Owners Kiran Kumar Vellanki and David Patel opened Coastal Curry on August 15, specializing in Hyderabadi Dum Biryani and dosas alongside North Indian favorites.
food.nri_angle: Coastal Curry fills a gap for Indian-Americans in Southern Maine seeking authentic South Indian dishes like Hyderabadi Dum Biryani and dosas closer to home.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Jaipur Couple Builds ₹2.4 Crore Organic Farm With 100 Gir Cows
food.excerpt: Vibhor and Ishita Jain turned a ₹20-25 lakh investment into Kinaya Organic Farms, producing A2 Gir cow milk, hand-churned ghee, and wood-pressed oils across a 12-acre property outside Jaipur.
food.image_caption: A purebred Gir bull, the indigenous Indian cattle breed. The Jaipur couple's farm houses 100 Gir cows producing A2 milk and organic dairy products.
food.nri_angle: NRI consumers have driven demand for premium A2 desi ghee and milk products, with brands already exporting internationally — this farm represents the kind of indigenous dairy entrepreneurship that is making those products commercially viable.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Needham's Masala Art to Close After 23 Years as Bank Takes Over Lease
food.excerpt: The Indian restaurant that brought subcontinental cuisine to the Boston suburb in 2003 will make way for a novel bank-and-pop-up-retail concept.
food.nri_angle: The closure of a longstanding Indian restaurant in a Boston suburb reflects challenges facing independent diaspora dining establishments across suburban America.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From Sweeping Floors to 20,000 Cups a Day: The Remarkable Story of Café Niloufer's Babu Rao
food.excerpt: A. Babu Rao arrived in Hyderabad with nothing, worked as a cleaner at a small tea café, and built it into India's largest chai chain — one kadak cup at a time.
food.image_caption: A. Babu Rao at Café Niloufer in Hyderabad, the tea chain he built from a single outlet into India's largest chai café. The business now spans multiple locations across the city, including HITEC City and Hyderabad Airport.
food.nri_angle: Café Niloufer's Irani chai is a taste of home for Hyderabadi NRIs worldwide, and Babu Rao's rags-to-riches story resonates with the Indian immigrant experience.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: FSSAI Crackdown on Misleading Food Labels Hits Dabur, Marico, Ferrero and More
food.excerpt: India's food safety regulator has issued notices to dozens of companies over misleading '100%' claims, fake organic labels, and unsubstantiated health claims, forcing brands from Dabur to MasterChow to overhaul their packaging.
food.nri_angle: The crackdown on misleading food labels in India is relevant to NRI consumers who purchase Indian food products abroad or during visits, and who rely on labelling claims when choosing imported Indian brands.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: De Ja Vu Opens at Southampton Royal Pier, Reviving Indian Dining at a Historic Waterfront Venue
food.excerpt: The contemporary Indian restaurant replaces the former Kuti's Brasserie at the Grade II listed pier where Queen Victoria's own love of curry helped shape British dining history.
food.nri_angle: Southampton's Indian diaspora community has helped build one of the south coast's strongest Indian dining scenes, with multiple restaurants earning national recognition.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From Ballia to Beijing: How an IAS Officer Turned UP's Forgotten Sattu Into a Global Superfood Brand
food.excerpt: Rebranded as 'Sattu Pops' under the One District One Product scheme, Ballia's traditional roasted gram flour is now sold on Amazon, stocked in post offices, and served in Chinese university cafeterias.
food.image_caption: Sattu, a roasted gram flour from eastern Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, is gaining recognition as a high-protein superfood. An IAS officer's initiative has helped take the traditional staple from Ballia to international markets.
food.nri_angle: NRIs seeking affordable Indian protein alternatives to Western supplements can now order Ballia's sattu products on Amazon; the ODOP success story shows Indian food heritage going global.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Indian Street Food Brand Puchkaman Makes Global Debut With First Toronto Location
food.excerpt: The Kolkata-born QSR chain, backed by Wow! Momo co-founder, opens at Scarborough's Danforth Avenue as Indian food brands accelerate their North American expansion.
food.image_caption: Pani puri, one of India's most beloved street foods. The Indian street food brand Puchkaman has opened its first international location in Toronto.
food.nri_angle: Indian food brands are increasingly targeting diaspora communities in Toronto and across Canada, bringing authentic regional street food to markets long dominated by generic Indian fine dining.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Nag Panchami 2026: Why Sutafeni Kheer Is the Festival's Most Cherished Offering
food.excerpt: As Hindu families prepare to celebrate Nag Panchami on August 17, the delicate saffron-infused vermicelli dessert remains central to the day's rituals and the tradition of breaking Sawan's fasting restrictions.
food.image_caption: A devotثee offers milk to a serpent idol during Nag Panchami, the annual Hindu festival honouring serpent deities celebrated during the month of Shravan.
food.nri_angle: Sutafeni ingredients are readily available at Indian grocery stores across the US, UK, and Canada, making this a simple way for NRI families to observe Nag Panchami traditions.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Rat Found in Blinkit Ice Cream Freezer at Thane Dark Store
food.excerpt: A rat was spotted inside an ice cream freezer at a Blinkit dark store in Thane, raising fresh concerns about food safety standards in India's booming quick commerce industry.
food.nri_angle: Food safety concerns in India's quick commerce sector affect diaspora families who rely on delivery apps when visiting home and track consumer safety standards in the Indian market.

food.title: Two Bengaluru Sisters Turned Their Grandmother's Biryani Into a 28-Outlet Empire
food.excerpt: Ramya and Shweta Ravi launched RNR Donne Biryani from a 200 sq ft cloud kitchen during the pandemic with Rs 5 lakh. Five years later, they have 28 locations and are expanding to Chennai.
food.image_caption: Ramya Ravi, co-founder of RNR Donne Biryani, at one of the brand's Bengaluru outlets. The sisters have expanded their grandmother's recipe into a 28-location chain across the city.
food.nri_angle: The story introduces NRIs to donne biryani — a lesser-known Karnataka variety most diaspora Indians haven't encountered — and showcases women-led food entrepreneurship in India.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Record Sargassum Surge Smothers Caribbean Beaches as Mexico Scrambles to Protect Tourism
travel.excerpt: Mexico has cleared over 105,000 metric tons of seaweed this year — already surpassing 2025's record — as NASA data shows the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt near all-time highs.
travel.image_caption: A NASA satellite map shows the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt spanning from West Africa to the Caribbean. The 2026 bloom has reached near-record levels, with the Gulf of Mexico doubling its previous sargassum record.
travel.nri_angle: Indian diaspora travelers planning Caribbean or Mexico beach vacations this fall should check sargassum tracking tools before booking, as popular destinations including Cancun, Tulum, and Playa del Carmen face record seaweed inundation through October.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Saudi Arabia Launches One-Year Multiple-Entry Umrah Visa With 90-Day Stay
travel.excerpt: The new visa lets pilgrims visit Makkah and Madinah multiple times within 365 days, but each trip requires a fresh service package and Umrah permit booked through the Nusuk platform.
travel.nri_angle: India sends one of the largest Umrah pilgrim contingents each year, and the new multiple-entry visa eliminates the need for repeat applications, benefiting Indian Muslim families planning frequent visits.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Uttarakhand's Butter Festival Turns an Alpine Meadow Into a Sea of Makhan
travel.excerpt: The annual Anduri Utsav at Dayara Bugyal sees 500 villagers trek to 3,400 meters to play Holi with fresh butter and buttermilk in one of India’s most unique cultural celebrations.
travel.nri_angle: The Butter Festival offers diaspora travelers a unique cultural experience tied to pastoral Himalayan traditions, with late-August timing that aligns with school breaks abroad.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Andhra Pradesh's New Bhogapuram Airport Launches Commercial Flights on August 17
travel.excerpt: The Rs 5,000 crore Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport replaces Visakhapatnam's old military-shared terminal, with three airlines flying to 10 destinations including Singapore.
travel.nri_angle: North Andhra NRIs gain a modern international airport with direct Singapore service, replacing the old military-shared Visakhapatnam terminal that forced overseas travelers to connect through other cities.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Seoul's Incheon Overtakes Heathrow as World's Busiest International Airport
travel.excerpt: South Korea's flagship airport recorded 38.4 million international passengers in the first half of 2026, claiming the top spot from London Heathrow for the first time in its 25-year history.
travel.nri_angle: Incheon's rise as the world's busiest international airport is relevant to Indian travelers who increasingly use it as a transit hub for North America, and its Skytrax #2 ranking makes it a notable competitor to traditional routing through Dubai and Singapore.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: SAS Confirms October 1 Launch for Copenhagen-Mumbai Route After Mid-Air Turnaround
travel.excerpt: Scandinavian Airlines secures all regulatory approvals for its return to India after 17 years, with five weekly Airbus A330 flights connecting Denmark to Mumbai.
travel.nri_angle: New direct route connecting Indian travelers to Scandinavia and onward to North America via Copenhagen hub; relevant for NRIs in Nordic countries and travelers from India.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: MakeMyTrip Launches 350 Guided Tours Across India With Tourism Ministry
travel.excerpt: The collaboration offers curated experiences led by local experts across more than 60 Indian cities, bookable on the platform starting August 15.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs planning trips to India can now book curated guided tours across 60+ cities through MakeMyTrip, making it easier to explore destinations beyond familiar tourist circuits.

carousel.excerpt: EB-1A approval rates for Indians fell sharply in FY26, with immigration attorneys warning of an 'unreasonably high bar' despite no change in law.

carousel.title: Delhi Police Tells Supreme Court No Excessive Force Used Against Student Protesters
carousel.excerpt: In its counter-affidavit, Delhi Police called the July 20 Sansad Chalo march 'illegal' and said 5,000 officers managed a crowd of over 30,000 amid stone-pelting by 'miscreants.'
carousel.nri_angle: The student protests over NEET exam integrity have drawn international attention and prompted concerns among Indian-Americans about the fairness of competitive examinations that affect families across the diaspora.

carousel.title: Indian Box Office Surges as Hollywood Blockbusters and Bollywood Hits Fill Theaters Simultaneously
carousel.excerpt: Spider-Man, The Odyssey, and Awarapan 2 are driving a rare multi-front box office boom in India, boosting PVR INOX's financials and signaling a structural recovery in theatrical exhibition.
carousel.image_caption: A movie theater in India draws crowds. Indian cinemas are seeing a rare box office surge with Hollywood and Bollywood releases running simultaneously.
carousel.nri_angle: For NRIs who grew up watching Emraan Hashmi films and follow both Hollywood and Bollywood releases, the current box office surge reflects a theatrical revival that could reshape how Indian content reaches global audiences.

carousel.title: Knight Riders Group Eyes The Hundred Entry as Expansion to Ten Teams Gains Momentum
carousel.excerpt: Having passed on buying existing franchises, KKR's owners could target a new team if the ECB adds ninth and tenth franchises — a move league officials have called a 'no-brainer.'
carousel.image_caption: The Kolkata Knight Riders celebrate during an IPL match. The Knight Riders Group is exploring a bid for a team in The Hundred as the English league considers expansion to ten teams.

carousel.title: Acer Launches Predator Helios Gaming Laptops in India With RTX 5080 and Arrow Lake
carousel.excerpt: Three new models bring Nvidia Blackwell GPUs and Intel Arrow Lake processors to Indian gamers and creators, starting at Rs 2,42,990.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian tech enthusiasts and NRIs considering laptop purchases in India can now access RTX 50 Series hardware at launch, a shift from the delayed availability typical of previous generations.

carousel.title: Maruti Suzuki Fronx Becomes Fastest Indian SUV to Cross 2 Lakh Exports
